# `fnox lease list`

- **Usage:** `fnox lease list [--active] [--expired]`

List tracked leases

## Flags

- **`--active`** — Show only active (non-expired, non-revoked) leases
- **`--expired`** — Show only expired leases
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

<!-- fnox examples:start -->

## Examples

Inspect the local lease ledger. This is a record of leases tracked by fnox, not a complete inventory of credentials at the service.

```sh
fnox lease list --active
fnox lease list --expired
```
